issues.body: Section 3 still says there are 16 marker sites, 10 corrected, and 6 untouched. At the PR head, `rg -n 'M2-next:' crates/sparq-lws-core/src` finds 8 literal occurrences: notifications/ws.rs (3), notifications/mod.rs (1), store/reconcile.rs (1), lib.rs (1), store/blob.rs (1), and ldp/content.rs (1). In particular, the claimed untouched inventory says `store/blob.rs` ×3 and `store/sparq.rs`, but the former has one literal occurrence and the latter has none. The table also labels notifications as ×3 although four literal marker occurrences remain there. Thus the claimed exhaustive sweep is still neither arithmetically nor factually reproducible.
issues.fix_hint: Re-run and document the inventory against both the base and PR head. Define explicitly whether a site is a literal marker occurrence, a changed diff hunk, or a conceptual deferred item; do not mix those units. Update the 16/10/6 totals, the stale/corrected breakdown, the notifications count, and the untouched-site list so every count is reproducible from the stated method. If conceptual items are useful, list them separately from literal marker occurrences.
issues.title: M2-next sweep inventory still does not match the PR head

verdict.summary: Round 4 is stagnant. The sole major finding from round 3 remains materially unchanged: the triage record still claims an exhaustive inventory of 16 `M2-next:` marker sites, with 10 corrected and 6 untouched, but the PR-head crate contains only 8 literal occurrences. The stated remaining-site breakdown is also inconsistent with the tree: `store/blob.rs` has one literal occurrence rather than three, and `store/sparq.rs` has none. Because section 3 explicitly presents these numbers as the verified basis for the sweep and deferred-item accounting, this remains a correctness/completeness defect in the load-bearing triage evidence.
